versions.content: When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength exceeding the length of the global PDU (see [ECUC_EcuC_00078]) refer- enced by TxPduId and CanIfTxPduTruncation is enabled, CanIf shall transmit data up to the length of the global PDU (see [ECUC_EcuC_00078]) and discard the rest.

When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength exceeding the maximum length of the PDU referenced by TxPduId and CanIfTxPduTruncation is enabled, CanIf shall transmit as much data as possible and discard the rest.

When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength exceeding the length of the global PDU (see [ECUC_EcuC_00078]) refer- enced by TxPduId and CanIfTxPduTruncation is enabled, CanIf shall transmit data up to the length of the global PDU (see [ECUC_EcuC_00078]) and discard the rest.
